name: Cline
invoke: /mps-<role>.md (workflow), or paste `mps agents show <role>` into a new task
notes: Workspace workflows live in .clinerules/workflows/ and are invoked as /<file>.md. Cline's own subagents are automatic research agents, not file-defined roles, so a workflow is the right target. AGENTS.md support is still an open discussion in the Cline repo, so the routing block goes to .clinerules/ first and AGENTS.md second.
